The '''Karamja Volcano''' is located on the island of [[Karamja]] between [[Brimhaven]] to [[Musa Point]]. An [[rocks (Karamja Volcano)|entrance]] at the top leads to the [[Crandor and Karamja Dungeon]], providing passage to [[Mor Ul Rek]] and [[Crandor]].

==Transportation==
To reach the Karamja Volcano, one can use one of the following methods. 

* Teleport with an [[amulet of glory]] to the docks north-east in Musa Point, and run west.
* From [[Port Sarim]], pay the 30-coin fare to [[Captain Tobias]], [[Seaman Lorris]], or [[Seaman Thresnor]] to sail to Musa Point, then run west.
* Sail to Musa Point using [[Sailing#Shipbuilding|your ship]], or any [[Charter ship|charter ship]], then run west.
* Sail to Brimhaven using any charter ship, then run south-east.
* From [[Shilo Village]], pay the 200 coin fare for the [[Shilo Village cart system]] to travel to Brimhaven, then run south-east.
* Take a [[Fairy rings|fairy ring]] to {{Fairycode|blp}} to  arrive in Mor UI Rek, run north-east to the [[cave exit (Mor Ul Rek)|Cave exit]], then climb the nearby rope to reach the surface.

== Features ==
* Several low-level monsters, such as [[Imp|imps]], [[Scorpion|scorpions]], [[Snake|snakes]], and [[Monkey|monkeys]] can be found roaming around.
* There is one [[seaweed]] spawn at the north-east edge of the volcano near a group of tropical trees.
* Many [[Dead tree|dead trees]] can be found at the top of the volcano.
